heading: Wednesday, January 14, 2026
topLine: Z.ai releases GLM-Image, trained on Huawei Ascend chips.

items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-Image, trained on Huawei Ascend chips
items.summary: GLM-Image is an open-source 16B image generation model that combines a 9B autoregressive model based on GLM-4 with a 7B diffusion decoder, aimed at better text rendering in images. Z.ai says it was trained entirely on Huawei Ascend hardware with the MindSpore framework.
